args.sql: SELECT r.riskandmarginpivot, r.ordervault, o.userlink FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault LIMIT 5;
SELECT ab.accountbalancesnode, ab.walletsum, ab.usertag FROM accountbalances ab LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    r.riskandmarginpivot,
    r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn' AS posmagn,
    r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum' AS possum,
    ab.walletsum,
    calc_effective_leverage(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn', 
                            CAST(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum' AS NUMERIC), 
                            ab.walletsum) AS effective_leverage,
    CASE 
        WHEN calc_effective_leverage(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'posmagn', 
                                      CAST(r.risk_margin_profile->'position'->>'possum' AS NUMERIC), 
                                      ab.walletsum) > 20 THEN 'High Risk'
        ELSE 'Normal'
    END AS risk_classification
FROM riskandmargin r
JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
JOIN accountbalances ab ON ab.usertag = u.userstamp
LIMIT 10;
